create_graph: create a gtn Graph object to build a finite state transducer recognizing a pattern
add_node: add a start or final node to a gtn Graph with optional is_start and is_final flags
add_arc: add an arc between two nodes in a gtn Graph with a symbol label
draw_graph: draw a gtn Graph to a PDF file with symbol labels for nodes and arcs
union_graphs: union multiple gtn Graph objects into a single combined graph
